paleoarchean-era-begins.why: obscure eon name, but stromatolites and microbes place it very early in Earth history

mesoarchean-era-begins.why: microbes only, so very early, though easily confused with neighbouring eras

rhyacian-period-begins.why: oxygen and early glaciation suggest the early-middle deep past, but no precise era

mesoproterozoic-era-begins.why: calm climate and complex cells could fit a wide span of the Precambrian

neoproterozoic-era-begins.why: Rodinia and snowball-type cold put it late Precambrian, before animals

cambrian-period-opens.why: the Cambrian explosion is taught widely and the text says it outright

late-devonian-epoch-begins.why: first forests and armoured fish place it mid-Palaeozoic, after Cambrian, before dinosaurs

pennsylvanian-epoch-begins.why: coal swamps and first reptiles point to the late Palaeozoic

late-triassic-epoch-begins.why: early dinosaurs on a supercontinent place it at the dawn of the Mesozoic

late-jurassic-epoch-begins.why: Jurassic plus Stegosaurus and sauropod cues are well known

late-cretaceous-epoch-begins.why: T. rex and Triceratops cues put it at the end of the dinosaur age
